# Evidence Method

Claims remain paired with measurements, freshness context, and an explicit limitation.

| Evidence | Source | Limitation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Climate trend | Public reporting tier | Historical, not control authority |
| Planning record | Bounded planner | Proposal, not a safety rail |
